blocks.text: 🪝 US President Donald Trump Announces Phased 200% Tariff Policy on Generic Drug Imports. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Imposes zero-percent tariff for 2 years (from Aug 2026), 100% in Aug 2028, and 200% in Aug 2029.
Phased Tariff Schedule: 0% tariff (Aug 2026 – July 2028), 100% (Aug 2028 – July 2029), 200% (from Aug 2029).
India Impact: Impacts >40% of India's .5 billion generic pharma exports to the US.
0% tariff phase (2 years) vs 100% phase (1 year) vs 200% phase (permanent after 2029).
